description: This file defines the 'Function' class for the mobile submodule of the Torch JIT framework. It manages execution, code, and schema for functions executed in a mobile environment, including methods to append instructions, constants, and operators, as well as handling function registration and initialization.

classes.name: Function
classes.description: Represents a callable function in the mobile JIT environment, managing code execution, schema, constants, and instructions.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the function with the provided stack.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Calls the function as a functor with the given stack, returning an IValue.

methods.name: append_instruction
methods.description: Adds an instruction with an opcode and optional debug handle to the function's code.

methods.name: append_operator
methods.description: Adds an operator to the function by name, overload, and argument specification.

methods.name: append_constant
methods.description: Adds a constant value to the function's constants pool.

methods.name: append_type
methods.description: Adds a type to the function's type list.

methods.name: append_function
methods.description: Appends another mobile::Function to this one.

methods.name: initialize_operators
methods.description: Loads operators into the function, ensuring all are supported in the current runtime.

methods.name: set_register_size
methods.description: Sets the size of the register used during execution.

methods.name: get_code
methods.description: Returns the Code object associated with the function, const and non-const versions.

methods.name: qualname
methods.description: Returns the qualified name of the function.

methods.name: getSchema
methods.description: Returns the function schema if set.
